description.value: Heartland Restaurant is a diner in McBride, BC, situated in the Robson Valley along the Yellowhead Highway (Highway 16). McBride is a small but key community on the cycling corridor connecting Prince George to Jasper, Alberta, making local food service stops valuable for self-supported touring cyclists. The restaurant is one of the sit-down dining options in this remote stretch of the Interior.
